name: Graham Pike
background: Twenty-two years with Mercantile, the last six running Harbour Street. Discovered the empty boxes on Tuesday morning.
motive: His own accounts are overdrawn and head office has been asking why.
opportunity: Holds one half of the combination and keys to every door in the branch.
accessLevel: Branch keys; half the vault combination

relationships.note: Pays Doreen for extra cleans out of his own pocket.

name: Rosa Delgado
background: Senior engineer at Fortress Alarms. Services the Harbour Street panel every quarter, and did so on Saturday afternoon.
motive: Fortress has lost two contracts this year; the rumour is she's looking for a way out.
opportunity: Was inside the branch with the alarm in test mode on the Saturday.
accessLevel: Engineer's code for the alarm panel

name: Walter Kemp
background: Served twelve years for safe-breaking. Came out in 1983 and opened a key shop directly across Harbour Street from the bank.
motive: Old habits, say the police. He says he's never been more honest.
opportunity: Knows safes better than anyone in Ridgeway, and lives fifty yards from the vault.
personality: Gruff, dry, tired of being the first name on every list.

name: Edwin Thorne
background: Head Office Audit for twenty years. Audited Harbour Street on Thursday afternoon, then drove to his sister's in Millbrook for the holiday.
motive: None on the record. Unmarried, careful, respected.
opportunity: Was fifty miles away all weekend. Or so he says.
accessLevel: Head Office audit code; access to the combination envelopes at audit

relationships.note: Has written Pike up for untidy books.

name: Doreen Walsh
background: Has cleaned the Harbour Street branch for nine years. Knows which floorboard squeaks and who leaves their coffee cups.
motive: Short of money since her husband's layoff.
personality: Chatty until she's frightened, then not at all.

relationships.note: Likes Mr Pike. Doesn't like the man from head office.
